components.text: The [color=yellow]Solar Panel [color]is a basic power generator that uses sun light as fuel. It provides a steady supply of energy for your machines and devices, making it an essential component for any off-earth colony.

[br] [br] How to use : [br] Place the solar panel in a suitable location with sun access and connect it to your power grid. The generator will produce energy over time. [br] [br] Stats : [br] - Power Output : 1 FE/t
